info.title: LF Edge eKuiper REST Management API
info.description: Authoritative OpenAPI contract for the management REST routes registered by LF Edge eKuiper v2.4.1. Optional components depend on build tags; JWT authentication, when enabled, expects a raw RS256 token in the Authorization header.

externalDocs.description: Tagged eKuiper v2.4.1 REST API documentation

tags.name: System
tags.description: System information, health, runtime configuration, metrics, shutdown, and batch requests.

tags.name: Rule Test
tags.description: Temporary ten-minute rule trial runs. SSE results use the separately configured HTTP server port.

tags.name: Tracing
tags.description: Local rule traces and optional remote OpenTelemetry collection.

tags.name: Data
tags.description: Full JSON/YAML configuration import/export and asynchronous tasks.

tags.name: Uploads
tags.description: Files stored below the eKuiper data uploads directory.

tags.name: Plugins
tags.description: Native and portable plugin management. Native routes require a non-core/plugin build; portable routes require a non-core/portable build.

tags.name: Schemas
tags.description: Schema registry management. protobuf and custom schema types are registered in non-core/schema builds.

tags.name: UDF
tags.description: JavaScript UDF management; available in full/script builds.

tags.name: Services
tags.description: External service management; available in non-core/service builds.

tags.name: Metadata
tags.description: UI metadata, configuration keys, resources, and connectivity tests; available in non-core/ui builds.

JwtToken.description: Optional eKuiper RS256 JWT authentication. Supply the raw compact JWT without a Bearer prefix. The token audience must contain eKuiper.

ContentLanguage.name: Content-Language
ContentLanguage.description: Metadata language, for example en-US or zh-CN.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid JWT when authentication is enabled

ErrorResponse.description: Error envelope emitted by eKuiper. Most handlers serialize this JSON value through http.Error, so the HTTP Content-Type may be text/plain even though the payload is JSON.
